name: smoke-testing
purpose: Read-only, evidence-based, fingerprint-aware backend/frontend/integration/E2E aliveness checks with regex-driven stack/route discovery, a persistent dependency-aware TODO, an append-only audit trail, and a formal change-approval gate before any codebase modification.
invariant: READ-ONLY toward the application codebase, config, dependencies, schema, migrations, env files, and deployment/CI config unless the user explicitly approves a named change per change request. Freely creates/updates only within the project's .smoke-test/ directory (Zone A). Never infers approval from silence, an unrelated prior approval, or a change merely looking safe.
levels: 0: discovery (stack, routes, DB technology, config-mismatch checks, TODO build/refresh)
1: backend (health, readiness/DB, auth, core business flow, error-handling sanity)
2: frontend (app load, critical routes, critical elements, one basic interaction)
3: integration (real frontend -> real backend -> real DB, one critical workflow)
4: critical E2E (the 1-3 workflows the user names as most important)

invocationContract.calledBy: parent orchestrator (e.g. testing-audit-debugging-protocol, only after audit-report approval), or directly by the user
expectsInput: optional: approvedAuditReport reference, if invoked from an orchestrator

hardConstraints: never modifies application source code, migrations, or run configs without an explicit, named approval per change request (see references/change-control.md)
never infers approval from silence, a prior unrelated approval, or a change merely looking safe
always distinguishes FAIL (ran, didn't pass) from BLOCKED (couldn't meaningfully run) from AWAITING_USER (fix proposed, decision pending)
never deletes or rewrites prior reports/history/ entries or audit.jsonl lines
never runs destructive/write core-flow checks unless smoke-config.json's test_environment.allow_writes is explicitly true, and then only against the configured smoke-test fixture account
re-validates 'passed' TODO items via fingerprint comparison before trusting them on a subsequent run

filesCreatedInProject.why: scope/endpoints/routes/auth and the write-safety gate, so runs are repeatable without re-asking every time
discovery cache + fingerprints for staleness detection + the authoritative change-request log
persistent, dependency-aware checklist so state survives across sessions and interruptions
append-only trail proving no MODIFY/DELETE happened without a preceding approval
human- and machine-readable audit trail of every run, live and final, with full history retained

orchestratorNotes: When invoked by a parent orchestrator, read its approved audit report first and run only what it asked for, but still write to .smoke-test/ and audit.jsonl in the standard shape described above so the orchestrator can aggregate results rather than needing a bespoke output format. This skill's own definition (skills/smoke-testing/) never gets project-specific results written into it — see references/state-management.md 'Skill vs project separation'.
